::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 21st 1872  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell.
:::

Madam,

I am glad that the introduction of that letter has been serviceable.  I am afraid though that I do not see any prospect of being able to make room for the story from Mrs Charlesworth as I am engaged to serials for a great way on[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The well-known children's writer Maria Louisa Charlesworth was unmarried, so it is not clear if this reference is to her or not.  Her work was probably too Low Church for *MP* and possibly the rather chilly tone of this note is connected with CMY's view of her works.
